ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Interview_Status__c, "Rescheduled"), ISPICKVAL(Interview_Status__c, "Cancelled"), ISPICKVAL(Interview_Status__c, "No Show") ), ISPICKVAL(Status_New_Reason__c, "") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Status Reason is required when Interview Status is Rescheduled, Cancelled, or No Show
